Hi there! The quickest way to see if the slowdown you noticed was a platform‑wide issue is to check Meridian’s status page.

1. Open the status page (status.meridian.com).
2. Look at the incident history for the time window when you experienced the slowdown (the page shows exact start and end times for every incident, even brief ones).
3. If an incident is listed for that period – especially one affecting the Dashboard or API components – it was a platform‑wide degradation that other customers would have seen.
4. If nothing appears for that window, the slowdown was most likely local to your environment (e.g., a browser extension, network conditions, or a large data load in your workspace).

The status page also breaks down incidents by component, so you can confirm whether a specific symptom matches a listed event. Let us know if you need any more help!
